name: personal-toolkit
description: Personal oh-my-pi (omp) plugin marketplace — every plugin authored by anhhung04, including private repos fetched over SSH

metadata.description: Personal toolkit: Docker, IaC, OFX, Obsidian memory, vulnerability hunting, patch-to-PoC diffing and OSINT skills.

plugins.name: omp-docker
plugins.description: Native Docker tools and skills for omp — containers, images, builds, Compose projects, Swarm clusters, agent sandboxes, networks, volumes, diagnostics and cleanup.

plugins.name: omp-iac
plugins.description: Infrastructure-as-Code tools and skills for omp — OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi and the Floci local cloud emulator.

plugins.name: omp-ofx
plugins.description: OFX red-team workflow engine integration for omp — run/list/validate workflows, detached sessions and fleets, cloud profiles/instances, config and module scaffolding.

plugins.name: omp-memory-obsidian
plugins.description: Long-term memory for omp backed by a plain Obsidian vault — wiki-linked topic pages, append-only daily logs, prompt-time recall and turn-cadence retention via the extension API.

plugins.name: pi-vuln-hunting
plugins.description: Vulnerability hunting, 0-day finding, code review and auditing: inventory-before-audit pipeline with an agent swarm, persisted findings and live PoC validation in Docker/cloud labs.

plugins.name: pi-patchleak
plugins.description: Patch-to-PoC diffing: compare two versions of a codebase, surface the security fix, and emit a structured leak report.

plugins.name: pi-osint
plugins.description: External OSINT and attack-surface skills package — recon methodology, autopilot pipeline, cloud/SaaS exposure and identity-provider recon.
